englishSummary.headline: Real-time protection support is limited to standard-harness agents
englishSummary.summary: The documentation now states that real-time protection for Copilot Studio agents is supported only when agents use the standard agent harness.
englishSummary.adminImpact: When planning protection for Copilot Studio agents, administrators should verify that the agents use the standard agent harness.

englishSummary.overview: Today's report includes 0 new, 10 updated, and 0 removed Microsoft Defender documentation files across 5 documentation areas.

groups.title: Defender for Endpoint
groups.summary: The documentation now states that, when using Windows Enterprise multi-session with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, all Azure Virtual Desktop users must have one of the listed licenses. The documentation now instructs administrators to verify the MDESupportTool signature and Microsoft signer details before running it. It also updates the documented SHA-256 hash and renumbers the procedure. The Defender for Endpoint connectivity table now lists https://ecs.office.com/config/v1 as an alternative to https://config.edge.skype.com/config/v1 for Linux internal configuration management.

groups.title: Defender for Cloud Apps
groups.summary: Administrators cannot create policies using the Last used condition. Evaluation of existing policies using it is paused, so they do not generate alerts or execute governance actions; their configurations remain unchanged. The documentation states that new policies cannot use the Last used condition, and existing policies using it are not evaluated. Their configurations remain unchanged.

groups.title: Defender for Cloud
groups.summary: The article now links to the SQL Servers on Machines MMA Helper workbook, includes a screenshot, adds Azure Resource Graph Explorer steps, and provides a service-principal option for connecting machines with Azure Arc at scale. The matrix changes Defender for Open-Source Relational Databases from Preview to GA in the affected entries. It continues to cover threat detection for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MariaDB in supported environments.

groups.title: Defender for Identity
groups.summary: The Suspected identity theft (pass-the-hash) and Remote code execution attempt alerts will be retired at the end of November 2026. Monitoring alternatives are Microsoft Defender for Endpoint behavioral blocking and containment, or custom detections in Advanced hunting.

groups.title: Defender XDR
groups.summary: The table documentation now lists the ApproverUpn string column, which contains the UPN of the person who approved a remediation action. The page date was also updated. The documentation now states that real-time protection for Copilot Studio agents is supported only when agents use the standard agent harness.
